assets.title: Week 6 opener multi-look board
assets.description: A compact opener board with 3 to 4 clearly different fashion looks that make color, silhouette, and first visual impression easy to notice.
assets.notes: Use as a fast review-preview board. Keep the looks visually different in color and silhouette so students can answer quick recognition questions without crowding.

assets.title: Color swatch and palette board
assets.description: One combined board showing basic color swatches and keyed palette examples for warm, cool, neutral, bright, soft, and monochrome.
assets.notes: Required visible-key strategy: A black, B white, C red, D blue, E green, F yellow, G warm palette, H cool palette, I neutral palette, J bright palette, K soft palette, L monochrome palette. The image, activity answers, and prompt notes must all use the same A-L labels.

assets.title: Shape, line, and silhouette board
assets.description: A combined board showing clear keyed examples of line direction, line shape, and garment silhouette comparisons.
assets.notes: Required visible-key strategy: A straight line, B curved line, C vertical line, D horizontal line, E diagonal line, F fitted silhouette, G loose silhouette, H straight silhouette, I flared silhouette, J oversized jacket, K cropped top. The image, activity answers, and prompt notes must all use the same A-K labels.

assets.title: Three-look reading gallery
assets.description: A reading gallery with three clearly separated looks for matching short visual descriptions to image A, image B, and image C.
assets.notes: Required image-key strategy: image A is a black and white look with a straight silhouette and strong contrast, image B is a soft warm look with a loose dress and curved lines, image C is a bright playful look with a cropped top and wide blue pants.

assets.title: Reusable four-look visual gallery
assets.description: A reusable gallery with four clearly separated fashion looks for listening, writing, and speaking.
assets.notes: Required image-key strategy: image A is a cool look with blue and green colors and a long straight silhouette, image B is a black-and-white contrast look with an oversized jacket and narrow pants, image C is a soft pink and flared-skirt look with curved lines, image D is a bright yellow-and-orange look with a playful impression and simple lines.

assets.title: Color, shape, and line listening audio
assets.description: A short Week 6 listening clip describing four looks by palette, color, silhouette, line, and overall impression.
assets.notes: Transcript remains inside audio_prompts.json only. Do not create a separate transcript asset in the current phase.
